generate_pybind11_dummy_code: generate C++ source code with pybind11 bindings for a given number of dummy classes
generate_boost_python_dummy_code: generate C++ source code with Boost.Python bindings for a given number of dummy classes
run_compile_benchmark: run the benchmark that compiles generated C++ code and measures build time and output size
review_benchmark_constants: review the nfns and nargs constants that control functions per class and arguments per function
summarize_benchmark_loop: summarize the module-level benchmark loop that iterates both code generators across exponentially growing class counts
